descriptorGaps.description: Current structured hints can describe some remoteRole and access costs, but direct Runner remote-contest intent remains mostly planner context.
Cheap early ICE and rush-score shape can be inferred only partially from current effects and roles; it remains a later ontology extension candidate.
Interface closeout is a DeckDoctrine aggregation over multiaccess density and central reach, not a per-card generic function tag.
AI019 records strategySupportPairs in the review report because the active hint schema still has independent lineSupport and strategicRole arrays.
